sources.quote: SUP-G,Minuterie Germanasca S.r.l.,"steel stampings, clips, pins"

findings.why: Viteria Lanzo does not appear in the supplier master or in the qualification records. Its standing (approved, conditional or blocked) is unknown, so a person (supplier quality) must answer.

sources.quote:
A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The ASL covers CL-115 for PLT-BEI and CUST-AUR, but only for SUP-G. Viteria Lanzo has no approval for this part, plant and customer.

sources.quote:
A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The ASL covers CL-115 for PLT-PIN and CUST-NOR, but only for SUP-G. Viteria Lanzo has no approval for this part, plant and customer.

sources.quote:
The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
after any of: a change of source
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: CL-115 is used on PRG-X (CUST-AUR). Revision 4 replaces revision 3 and requires written approval (PPAP) for a change of source, plus 90 days' notice. Nothing in force covers this change.

sources.quote:
A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before
the first shipment.

findings.why: CL-115 is also used on PRG-Y (CUST-NOR). A change of source needs Nordhavn approval before the first shipment, and no approval is on file.

sources.quote:
A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for
the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: No 3.1 certificate for C67S (the drawing material of CL-115) from Viteria Lanzo is on file. The supplier quality engineer (E. Gallo) must follow this up.
